_comment: Single source of truth for discovery queries. Read by skills/daily-sweep (what to run) and scripts/audit.py (what to expect). Replace these defaults with your own target titles; keep quotes and OR operators, the sweep issues the text verbatim. Set up a LinkedIn job alert (daily email) for each query too: the digests are the richest source.

light_mode._comment: Run when the fresh queue is over the gate threshold: remote only, primary queries only.
